endpoints.name: users_search_users
endpoints.description: Search Users [GET /users/search] Token: location or agency. Scopes: users.readonly.

companyId.description: Company ID in which the search needs to be performed

query.description: The search term for the user is matched based on the user full name, email or phone

locationId.description: Location ID in which the search needs to be performed

type.description: Type of the users to be filtered in the search

role.description: Role of the users to be filtered in the search

ids.description: List of User IDs to be filtered in the search

sort.description: The field on which sort is applied in which the results need to be sorted. Default is based on the first and last name

sortDirection.description: The direction in which the results need to be sorted

endpoints.name: users_filter_users_by_email
endpoints.description: Filter Users by Email Filter users by company ID, deleted status, and email array [POST /users/search/filter-by-email] Token: agency. Scopes: users.readonly.

emails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to filter users

skip.description: No of results to be skipped before returning the result (default: "0")

limit.description: No of results to be limited before returning the result (default: "25")

projection.description: Projection fields to return. Use "all" for all fields, or specify comma-separated field names. Default returns only id and email

endpoints.name: users_get_user
endpoints.description: Get User [GET /users/{userId}] Token: location or agency. Scopes: users.readonly.

endpoints.name: users_update_user
endpoints.description: Update User [PUT /users/{userId}] Token: location or agency. Scopes: users.write.

userId.description: Path parameter "userId", recovered from the URL template because the spec omits it.

email.description: Email update is no longer supported due to security reasons.

companyId.description: Company/Agency Id. Required for Agency Level access

scopes.description: Scopes allowed for users. Only scopes that have been passed will be enabled. If passed empty all the scopes will be get disabled

scopesAssignedToOnly.description: Assigned Scopes allowed for users. Only scopes that have been passed will be enabled. If passed empty all the assigned scopes will be get disabled

twilioPhone.description: Per-location inbound Twilio number in E.164 format, keyed by location id (Call and Voicemail Inbound Number for direct Twilio, not LC Phone). Replacement semantics: if you send twilioPhone in the request body, the stored map is replaced entirely with this object (not merged). Any location id omitted from the object is removed from the saved map. Omit the twilioPhone property entirely to leave existing numbers unchanged. Send an empty object {} to clear all per-location numbers. To clear a single location only, set that location id to an empty string "".

platformLanguage.description: Platform language preference for the user

endpoints.name: users_delete_user
endpoints.description: Delete User [DELETE /users/{userId}] Token: location or agency. Scopes: users.write.

userId.description: Path parameter "userId", recovered from the URL template because the spec omits it.

endpoints.name: users_get_user_by_location
endpoints.description: Get User by Location Deprecated. Use `GET /users/search` instead. Pass `locationId` as a query parameter to filter results by location, along with the required `companyId` and other search filters as needed. [GET /users/] Token: location. Scopes: users.readonly. DEPRECATED.

endpoints.name: users_create_user
endpoints.description: Create User [POST /users/] Token: location or agency. Scopes: users.write.

scopes.description: Scopes allowed for users. Only scopes that have been passed will be enabled. Note:- If passed empty all the scopes will be get disabled

scopesAssignedToOnly.description: Assigned Scopes allowed for users. Only scopes that have been passed will be enabled. If passed empty all the assigned scopes will be get disabled

Replacement semantics: if you send twilioPhone in the request body, the stored map is replaced entirely with this object (not merged). Any location id omitted from the object is removed from the saved map. Omit the twilioPhone property entirely to leave existing numbers unchanged. Send an empty object {} to clear all per-location numbers. To clear a single location only, set that location id to an empty string "".

platformLanguage.description: Platform language preference for the user
